{{Quote|Interplanetary squabbles and trade conﬂicts were as much a constant as always. At the urging of her friends in the government, Leia Organa Solo ran again for the post of New Republic Chief of State, and was elected back into that office in 21 ABY.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
The '''New Republic Presidential election of [[21 ABY/Legends|21 ABY]]''' saw [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] succeed [[Ponc Gavrisom]] as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
